candidates.name: WinHttpGetProxyResult
verified_facts: Retrieves an extended proxy resolution result after completion.
semantic_limits: A retrieved result still requires completion status, request-option application, endpoint observation, and connection readback.

candidates.name: WinHttpGetProxySettingsResultEx
verified_facts: Retrieves extended proxy settings after a completed WinHttpGetProxySettingsEx operation.
semantic_limits: Retrieved settings are configuration results and do not prove that a specific request applied them or that the selected route succeeded.

candidates.name: WinHTTP AutoProxy Support
verified_facts: Describes WinHTTP automatic proxy discovery, PAC processing, and related configuration paths.
semantic_limits: AutoProxy support can depend on user context, services, caches, WPAD, and PAC code; it is not deterministic endpoint identity evidence.

candidates.name: AutoProxy Issues in WinHTTP
verified_facts: Documents important WinHTTP auto-proxy limitations, caching, and proxy-list behavior.
semantic_limits: Known AutoProxy behavior can cause stale or first-entry routing; observed proxy use must be captured from the exact request context.

candidates.name: CertGetCertificateChain
verified_facts: Builds a certificate chain context from an end certificate toward a trusted root under specified usage and time parameters.
semantic_limits: A built chain can contain trust errors or use cached stores; chain construction alone is not successful SSL policy verification.

candidates.name: CERT_CHAIN_PARA
verified_facts: Defines requested usage and chain-building parameters.
semantic_limits: Usage and flags materially affect chain results; default or missing parameters must not be assumed to represent server-authentication policy.

candidates.name: CERT_CHAIN_CONTEXT
verified_facts: Contains candidate chains, trust status, and lower-quality chain contexts.
semantic_limits: A chain context is an evaluated snapshot and must be checked for trust status, policy, hostname, time, and exact leaf-certificate identity.

candidates.name: CERT_SIMPLE_CHAIN
verified_facts: Contains an ordered certificate chain and chain-level trust information.
semantic_limits: A simple chain may be one of several candidates; element order and trust status do not by themselves enforce SSL hostname policy.

candidates.name: CERT_CHAIN_ELEMENT
verified_facts: Contains a certificate context, trust status, and revocation information for one chain element.
semantic_limits: Element presence does not imply trust; every status field and the complete policy result must be evaluated.

candidates.name: CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy
verified_facts: Verifies a built chain against a selected policy such as SSL or Authenticode.
semantic_limits: Policy choice and extra policy parameters are essential; a generic or null policy does not automatically verify hostname or server usage.

candidates.name: CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_PARA
verified_facts: Defines flags and policy-specific input used for chain policy verification.
semantic_limits: Ignore flags can weaken verification and must be recorded; policy parameters do not themselves contain the result.

candidates.name: CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_STATUS
verified_facts: Receives chain-policy error status and failing chain or element indices.
semantic_limits: A zero error must be tied to the exact chain, policy, hostname, time, and leaf digest; stale status is not reusable evidence.

candidates.name: CertOpenStore
verified_facts: Opens a certificate store provider with selected location and flags.
semantic_limits: Opening a store does not establish that a certificate is trusted, current, private-key-backed, or used by the observed connection.

candidates.name: CertFindCertificateInStore
verified_facts: Searches a certificate store using a selected comparison type.
semantic_limits: Search criteria can be broad or ambiguous; a match must be identified by encoded certificate digest and intended usage.

candidates.name: CertGetCertificateContextProperty
verified_facts: Retrieves a selected property associated with a certificate context.
semantic_limits: Certificate-context properties can be store metadata or cached values and do not replace encoded certificate parsing or policy verification.

candidates.name: CertGetNameStringW
verified_facts: Formats a certificate name according to selected type and flags.
semantic_limits: Formatted names can be ambiguous, localized, or selected from multiple fields; they are not a stable certificate identifier.

candidates.name: CryptQueryObject
verified_facts: Determines the content and format of a cryptographic object and can return certificate, store, or message handles.
semantic_limits: Successful format detection does not prove signature validity, signer trust, object freshness, or relationship to the live TLS connection.
